seo.title: Private Driver in Korea | Pak Lee's Car
seo.description: A private van and driver for the whole day in Korea. No fixed route, no group. Fuel, tolls and insurance included. Message Pak Lee on WhatsApp.

hero.h1: You plan the day. I'll drive it.
hero.lede: A private van and one driver for the whole day — no fixed route, no group to keep up with, and no rush at the places you actually like.

message.body: No forms, and no deposit before we've spoken. Send me your dates and what you'd like to see. I'll tell you honestly what fits in a day and what doesn't.

chat.name: Rina
chat.text: Six of us, three kids. Nami Island on the 14th — possible?

chat.name: Pak Lee
chat.text: Yes. Six with luggage fits fine. I'd leave at eight, before the ferry queue.

chat.name: Pak Lee
chat.text: There is. I'll take you to one I eat at myself.

reels.h2: See a day, before you book one
reels.body: Short clips from real trips — guests saying hello, the places we stopped, and what the van actually looks like inside.

car.body: One van, kept clean, with room to actually stretch out. Eight seats, but it's most comfortable at five or six once the luggage is in.

rates.body: Priced per vehicle, not per person. The same price whether you're two or eight.

rows.name: Nami Island
rows.detail: 10 hours, with Petite France and the garden

rows.detail: Incheon to your Seoul hotel, one way

cta.h2: Where would you like to go?
cta.body: Tell me your dates. If it doesn't fit in one day, I'll say so.
